Loss report: gha -> woodpecker
[lost] pipeline/ci display.name (the Woodpecker workflow name is its file name; the display name is kept in round-trip metadata)
[lost] pipeline/ci/job/build job.if (no trigger of the pipeline has a Woodpecker event; the workflow never runs)
[lost] pipeline/ci/job/build job.runner (only a platform label has a Woodpecker form (labels.platform); other labels are lost)
[lost] pipeline/ci/trigger/0 ext.passthrough (Ext of provider gha (event, types) is not written to the Woodpecker file; it is kept in round-trip metadata)
[lost] pipeline/ci/trigger/0 trigger.api (Woodpecker starts API pipelines as manual events)
[lost] pipeline/ci/trigger/1 ext.passthrough (Ext of provider gha (event, inputs, secrets) is not written to the Woodpecker file; it is kept in round-trip metadata)
[lost] pipeline/ci/trigger/1 trigger.api (Woodpecker starts API pipelines as manual events)
[emulated] pipeline/ci/job/build job.container: default image ubuntu:latest (the job names no image, so steps without one run in ubuntu:latest)
[emulated] pipeline/ci/job/build/step/build-step-1 step.shell: bash-if-present wrapper command (the source runs the step under bash when the image has it; Woodpecker runs commands through /bin/sh -e of the image, so one command re-runs the script under bash -e when the image has bash, else under sh -e, and bash-only syntax fails under sh)
